title: The second box
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Gully leaves an EMPTY box on the porch. The pup guards it. The strip reconciles its own two dates with a joke.

panels.composition: The porch, morning. A produce box on the top step — the same stamp, ALICE'S WHOLESALE BAIT & SMOKED MEATS. GULLY walking away down the gravel, hands in pockets, not looking back. Exactly the Tier 1 of two years ago.

image.prompt: a wide view down a gravel driveway from a porch: a stocky man in a canvas jacket walking away toward a flatbed truck with his hands in his pockets, a waxed produce box on the top cedar step, a deliberate repeat of a familiar composition, clean ink with a light wash
image.notes: A deliberate repeat of 'The Box' Tier 1. Same everything.

panels.composition: The storm door. WOOD with the mug. BARNABY II shooting past his legs at the box.

characters.pose: in the door with a mug

image.prompt: a man opening a storm door with a coffee mug as a three-legged dog shoots past his legs toward a box on the step

panels.composition: The box, open. Empty. Shredded newspaper. A butcher-paper note in grease pencil: 'Nothing in it. Checking you still open the door. — G.'

image.prompt: close-up of an open produce box with only shredded newspaper inside and a butcher-paper note in blocky grease pencil taped to the side
image.notes: Letter after: Nothing in it. Checking you still open the door. — G.

panels.composition: The pup standing in the empty box, guarding it, chest out, three legs, exactly as if it were his again. Wood on the step, mug, reading the note, not laughing, almost.

characters.pose: standing in the empty box, chest out
on the step, note in hand

image.prompt: a three-legged dog standing proudly inside an empty produce box on a porch step, a man sitting beside it with a mug reading a note and almost smiling, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The brief's 2016 box, reconciled: empty, a check-in. 'Checking you still open the door.'
